title: The Caffeine History
description: All the projects in the "CaffeineMC" Organization. Supports 1.17.1
body:
# Features
The Caffeine History is a modpack that has all of the mods in the [CaffeineMC](https://modrinth.com/organization/caffeinemc) organization, an organization made by [Jellysquid](https://modrinth.com/user/jellysquid3) that has optimization mods like Sodium and Lithium, but also has older mods like Phosphor and Hydrogen. Thats why this modpack is only for version 1.17.1, its the only version that supports all four of those mods. In this modpack there are features like higher frame rates, less lag, less lag spikes, more optimized game and block phisics, more optimized mob ai, better block ticking, better lighting engine, reducing memory usage, and more! Thank you to Jellysquid for making the most of the mods in this modpack.
